notes: «وذكر، آخرين» is an unnamed gap: the text says others were named but does not name them, so it is one unnamed link at its place in the order
«- بصري -» is a gloss, left out
Sha'bi says «دخلت على فاطمة بنت قيس فسألتها»; Fatima's words («طلقها زوجها البتة») are the saying, so she is the last link
The footnote-like «- ... -» is absent; «قضاء، رسول الله» is scene, not a link
